source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: In your Shooting phase, once this model has finished shooting, pick an enemy unit that at least one of its attacks hit. For the rest of the phase, friendly models that have disembarked this turn from this **TRANSPORT** may re-roll **Wound rolls** for attacks against that unit.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 6 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

effect.appliesTo: friendly models that disembarked from this TRANSPORT this turn
